column1: # Catalogue of installable agent instructions, read by install-agent-instruct.sh.
# Tab-separated. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
#   slug         short id, used on the CLI and in the managed-block markers
#   basename     the snippet file in agents/, and the name it is copied/imported
#                as. ALWAYS UPPERCASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES.md — the installer enforces
#                this, so a re-run always targets the same file (no lowercase dupes).
#   title        short human label shown by --list
#   extras       OPTIONAL comma-separated companion basenames (e.g. PLANNER.md).
#                Copied into each agent's config dir as on-demand files — never
#                imported or inlined. A snippet references one via the {{CONFIG_DIR}}
#                token, which the installer renders to the agent's config dir.
# To add a new instruction: drop agents/NAME.md next to this file (uppercase +
# underscores) and add one row whose basename matches it exactly. Add companion
# files the same way and list their basenames in the extras column.
